We are starting over. What do we mean by that?

We are starting over with another cycle through the Insights from the Releasing The-LION-Syllabus.

The Rediscovery of The-HEART Institute is designed in such a way that each can study in his / her own pace. No one is ever behind.

Some of you are in your first reading; others have finished a second or even a third reading cycle.

Many of you keep saying things like 

  • 'Are you sure you have not been rewriting this syllabus?
  • I can't remember reading this the first time,
  • I don't remember this was here the first time;
  • it feels like it is completely different this time;
  • I see things I did not see before,
  •  My understanding is so much deeper this time around.'

We are being true to our statement that we base everything upon the Ancient-Hebrew Wisdom and that we look at Nature as our model to learn about Our-HEART.

The word 'Cycle' in the Ancient-Hebrew comes from a root word that means to return, to go back, to circulate, to restore, to refund, to bring back, to recover, to reflex, to rotate, to woo, to court, to rehearse, to reconstruct, to reproduce, to regret, to start over.

The Ancient-Hebrew teaches us that knowledge, wisdom, insight and mastery come from Iteration. Not as in taking in data and regurgitate them - that is only information. What we want is for the information to become Experiential. 

As Albert Einstein said – ALL LEARNING is Experiential.  All else is information. 

Each cycle builds upon the previous cycles. The growth in each cycle is Exponential.

There is a wise saying that says "you cannot compare the Wisdom and Insight a man gains by studying a subject for the 100th time with the Wisdom and Insight he gains after 101 times.

Mastery comes from iteration, repetition, rehearsal. A Master never leaves the basics.

Everything in Nature works according to the principle of cycling. Everything. And in these cycles each part of the cycle is inseparable connected to the other parts. Together they are the whole. At the same time each cycle is inseparable from the precious and future cycles, together they are the whole.

The whole discovery of the Fractal Geometry of Nature reveals this.

So we cannot ignore or neglect that principle if we really want to grow.

With each new cycle a whole new vista opens up for us. With each cycle we have internalized a piece of each of the 60 insights. And then, when we start over we READ with all that we already have inside us. This gives a new and deeper dimension through the new READING.

The-Genius in Our-HEART

Precious jewels are waiting to be SEEN in Ancient-Hebrew and they teach us wonderful insights of Who We Are and Why We DO What We Do.

Every Ancient-Hebrew word comes from a Root Word, mostly containing three ‘letters’ or more correct Word-IMAGES made up of three Word-IMAGES.

Can you already see the Fractal Design and Iteration?

The Ancient-Hebrew word for HEART is LEV; or even more fully LEVAV. Incredible treasures are hidden in this word.

The first Word-IMAGE is the Lamed (the ‘L’) – which is a picture of a shepherd staff.  l The Shepherd staff is a sign of authority, of guidance and direction. From the Word-IMAGE Lamed come all our Hebrew words for teaching, learning and studying.

The second (and third) letter is the Bet (in English the B or V) – which is a picture of a tentfloor, the Hebrew word for a HOME.

What a great IMAGE of The-Genius in Our-HEART learning; and also that Our-HEART is the control panel, where all our decisions are being made! Everything we know is stored in The-HEART and everything we do is based on what is stored in The-HEART.

So this means that it is important to know WHAT to store in The-HEART and HOW to store it. In other words: it is important to know HOW we Learn and WHO is Learning.

The right way to learn is being guided and taught by the Father-Mentor – the Primal Order of Learning.

The second and third letter are the same – fractal iteration – deeper and deeper – our Inner-Man – Spirit-Life.

So how do we learn? How do we process information?

We receive data, information through our senses. Those signals follow different neural pathways into the brain. All these signals are integrated into one experience in the IMAGE-Making areas of our brain. (Antonio Damasio). This experience is imprinted – an IMAGE formed and stored in our memory together with the way we feel about it and our interpretation of what this means. Each time we remember this experience our brain is using exact the same IMAGE-Making areas of the brain to recollect and re-experience the memory.

This is a continuing process ever. Neural pathways are formed, neural connections are being made. Ah, the Ancient-Hebrew word YTZR – to form, to mold, to shape. IMAGES are being formed, mold, shaped inside Our-HEART as we learn, experience and grow.

Each new bit of information changes the neural network in Our-HEART.

Sounds like IMAGE-Making to me.

Science calls this process "Neuroplasticity" – the process of forming and shaping and molding neural connections, pathways and networks in Our-HEART; and the capacity to reshape, reform and remold these connections, pathways and networks.

"Neuroplasticity has replaced the formerly-held position that the brain is a physiologically static organ, and explores how - and in which ways - the brain changes throughout life.[2]

Neuroplasticity occurs on a variety of levels, ranging from cellular changes due to learning, to large-scale changes involved in cortical remapping in response to injury. The role of neuroplasticity is widely recognized in healthy development, learning, memory, and recovery from brain damage" (Wikipedia)

The-Genius in Our-HEART forms and shapes and molds our Interior Design. It is not a passive or random process; it is highly active and engaged. Our-Genius loves to learn, it is designed to learn and explore, it is curious, creative and loves to play. It learns in two different ways:

  1. Learning new things
  2. Unlearning things that are outdated, untrue, unhelpful, unhealthy.

Didn’t we just see that the Learner - The-Genius is inside Our-HEART? The Lamed: The shepherd staff – authority, guidance, direction, teaching, learning, studying. The Bet: Inside The-HEART – The HOME of Our Inner-Man.

Genius is not taught . . .  Genius is The-Learner . . .

The-Genius in Our-HEART learns through the Primal Order of Learning.

It uses the IMAGE-Maker – to YTZR – to IMAGE, create, form, to mold, to shape.

It is the word for the impulses that trigger us to act. It is also the root for the Hebrew words "creativity", "manufacturing", "production". The IMAGES of the thoughts of My-HEART are forming and shaping the way I see myself. We see things the way WE Are. And those IMAGES produce my actions and behavior.

HEART to HEART

'We' just had another game and 'we' won again. 'We' are at the top of our group. 'We' is the Dutch soccer team. Growing up between 3 sport-loving brothers, I am infected with tournament fever. And something inside me wakes up every two years. The IMAGE for the Dutch team is a lion. Now, yes, we want to release The-LION inside us, but it is not remotely the same. It is related because it is a HEART-Issue. There is nothing rational about the tournament, it is raw experience. And it is utterly unimportant.But . . . it is absolute soulish Outer-Man programming. And it is utterly unimportant. It is totally a False Identity Issue. I am shamefully aware of my 'identification' with the Dutch players. I take it personally, the victory as well as the defeat; raw emotions coming from a deep place. It is 'Us' against 'the rest of the world'. Larry asked me what second team we favor. And I answered - half in disbelief over such and impossible question - "Larry, there IS NO SUCH THING as favoring another team!!!"Larry's question though pinpointed the issue, I am not alone. It is a deception I share with my family and many fellow countrymen. And watching the TV screen, I see the world caught up in the same illusion. I rejoice when 'we' score, I'm in pain when the opponents score. Not rejoicing with, not being happy about, it is intensely personal. I go through the roof when 'we' win, and I anguish when 'we' lose. And when 'we' get eliminated from the tournament I am deeply disappointed. I want to win. I want to taste the victory. The feeling of being the best, being on top. And I need the players to deliver it to me. And I hold them responsible if they fail to deliver. I say that I am shamefully aware of it. I am shameful because I cannot control it, it is stronger than my reasonable me wants it to be. Even though I like the 'thrill' it exposes a side in me that I would rather hide or deny. And because I know it has nothing to do with reality, with the real me. But the programming is strong and runs deep. There is some IMAGE inside My-HEART that unites me with 11 players on the field, and whatever they are doing there strongly affects My-HEART and the way I feel about what they are doing. I don't know them, but for some reason they are totally responsible for my well-being. We have nothing in common but a sense of 'we' that distinguishes 'us' from 'them'. That same IMAGE causes me to view the other 11 players on the field as my enemies for 90 minutes long. I don't know them, but for some reason they are MY personal enemies and they need to be defeated, so I can feel good and secure and proud of who I am. They have never done anything to hurt me, but they are a personal threat to me. I am experiencing on The-HEART-Level something that is utterly unimportant and that has absolutely nothing to do with me as a matter of Life & Death, and We Are At War. The flags, the playing of the national anthem are all reinforcing the Fractal. My 'normal' personality is totally thrown aside, like it does not even exist. Now, this temporary insanity is temporary indeed and it is pretty obvious. I leave it behind me the moment is over, go on with my life and deny the raw emotions just experienced. My 'normal' personality re-emerges and I shrug my shoulders to get rid of The-Lie that controlled me until a moment ago: this is the 'most important thing in my life'. The-Truth is: It is utterly unimportant. This one is obvious. How many other temporary insanity events do I have throughout my life and do not realize it? False identifications perceived as real, holding others personally responsible for my well-being or for my disappointments? For not delivering that which I perceive that I am wanting? How often have I expected from my husband or my kids to be or behave a certain way what would make me feel good? To satisfy a need that is mine? And blaming them for not performing? Totally self-centered; not seeing THEM at all? The more I get those places in My-HEART healed, the more I can get off their back . . . The Rediscovery of The-HEART is not about 'self-help'; it is about setting us free of the self-centeredness that we are trapped in. When we become aware of the 'false self' programming in Our-HEARTS, we can heal those places that cause us to protect, defend, promote or exalt our 'false self' and manipulate others. Our self-centeredness is not only expressed in 'bad' things we do, also the 'good' we do can be extremely self-centered, done to promote a 'positive' IMAGE that will cause you to believe that I am a good person, so that I can believe that I am a good person. Becoming free of that kind of self-centeredness will help me to become someone who can authentically SEE you and BE HERE for you. I am hopeful to grow into that a little bit more each day. The difference between the pretended and the authentic will be drastic.HEART to HEARTThea Benny

Why Our-LION Needs Nutrition

Last week Larry covered Roger Sperry and the Split Brain Research.

That is the research that revealed the difference in function between the right and left brain hemispheres.

These two hemispheres are not merely twins or mirror hemispheres, they are different in nature, by design. And they speak a different language.

That could be discovered only through the patients who had their corpus collosum severed and there is no direct contact between the two.

Unless you have had a corpus collosum surgery and had your two brain hemispheres separated, your two hemispheres are in direct contact and communication, inside your body.

Of course no one is a “Right-Brainer” or “Left-Brainer” only. We always use both, but we will tend to have one hemisphere to be stronger in certain functions.

Since we all have a Right-Brain, and we all function in life, we can state that we all have an IMAGE-Maker, and it makes IMAGES 24/7

These IMAGES are not limited to visual activity. As we learn from the video “Blind as a Bat” also the blind people make 3D IMAGES from their environment based on the sensory info coming from their other senses.

Blind people also SEE with their IMAGE-Maker.

Neurologist Antonio Damasio explains that every sensory input is translated into digital IMAGES.

Not so many years ago we did not have phones with a caller display. We had to actually answer the phone for the caller to reveal his identity.

Have you ever noticed that you instantly recognized the voice of a loved one before they could say their names? With that particular sound of that voice you would automatically and instantaneously have an IMAGE of that person.

content_html:
Promises of an Experience

Words have no MEANING until we Experience the Reality.

Throughout life, we are living one experience after the other. Once experienced, they are stored as memories and become a part of any relevant future experience.

At a certain point in life we start to anticipate the future, based on what we already have experienced. And as we learn more words, we start to anticipate future events we have not experienced yet. Some of those we await with eagerness, some we dread.

We also discover that our anticipation and the experience itself are not always congruent. In fact, how often do they really match? Some exceed our expectations, some stay below, and now we know the meaning of disappointment experientially.

Two weeks ago, the new school year started. The son of our friends started his first grade. He was excited about it and so were his parents, anticipating ‘something’. A step considered by many of us to be a milestone in our lives, we label it as ‘meaningful’; it tells us something about growing up.

But what does that experience actually mean? The meaning is revealed only when we start to experience reality. Experience cannot be taught. It has to be experienced, it have to be ‘lived’.

What it meant to their son was revealed pretty quickly . . . after a week he asked his parents if he could go back to kindergarten.

For years, I looked forward to be 18 years old. That sounded mature, and it had a fragrance of ‘freedom’ I desired so much. Being 18 years old meant to me ‘being free to do whatever I want’.

In reality, it did not exactly turn out that way.

Being married and being a mother – two experiences that were only a concept until the moment they became an experience - when I got married and when I became a mother. All of a sudden, the experience is ‘on’ and it appears to include a lot more than I had conceived conceptually. Simply because my IMAGE-Maker had not taken into account a lot of things, and had overemphasized other aspects, romanticized some. In some ways the experience of the reality is not what I had dreamed of, in some ways it is much better than I could ever dream of.

A friend just lost her sister. She had been sick for a long time. We talked about how we live with the conceptual knowledge that death is inevitable, it is only a matter of time. But knowing that, even knowing that it can or will happen any moment, does not prepare us for the raw experience when it happens. And when that moment comes, the irrevocable truth hits us in the face.

Concepts never prepare us for the experience itself. The difference is too drastic. We can have all the words in the world, but as long as their reality is not experienced, all we have are seeds at best.

“The Purpose of the Seed is to Release-the-Life. The Purpose of the Definition is to Release-the-MEANING. The Purpose of the Word is to Release-the-Experience.”

“Words have no MEANING until we EXPERIENCE The-Reality.”
